title: publish-release.sh discards the qualification-report download's stderr, so a failure there cannot say why
description: On the 0.9.1 publish (2026-09-24), the first run of scripts/publish-release.sh 0.9.1 35953824422 died with 'could not download the qualification reports' before any registry write. The download at scripts/publish-release.sh:329-330 redirects >/dev/null 2>&1, so the cause was lost. The identical gh run download by hand moments later exited 0 with 18 files, and the retry published. A redirected stderr cannot report its own breakage (fleet operating block, Tools). Capture stderr and print it in the die message; consider one bounded retry, since this is a read before any write.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A failing qualification-report download prints gh's own error text in the die message
Proven with a deliberately failing download (e.g. a bogus run id) showing the gh error, and a passing one unchanged
